thread:
lena (CS): FYI: early-morning issue (approx 02:05 UTC) caused a pause in final activation for a subset of new accounts. Seeing several 'activation pending' stuck states in the onboarding dashboard. Need a quick customer note + list of next steps.

omar (Eng): quick summary: config drift in our rate limiter interaction with the finalizer led to slow retries and eventually queue pressure; some jobs timed out rather than being retried. Root cause being rolled back config change from last night.

rachel (Ops): mitigation timeline: 02:08 detected spike; 02:12 rolled back rate-limiter change; 02:20 reprocessed backlog, 02:34 confirmed normal throughput. ~15 tenants delayed, 3 still showing pending due to webhook callback failures.

peter (CS): drafting external note. Keeping short: apologize, TL;DR, no data lost, how to get help, credit offer. Putting draft below.

peter (CS): ```Hi <Customer>,

TL;DR: Some onboarding activations were delayed this morning due to an internal retry/config issue. Most accounts completed automatically after we rolled back a recent config change. No data was lost.

What happened: between 02:05	2:35 UTC a configuration change caused retries to back off aggressively for the finalization step, which delayed some activations.

What we did: rolled back the config, retried queued activations, and confirmed successful completion for the majority of affected accounts. Three customers need manual assistance due to webhook timeouts.

How were protecting you: added an automated validation to prevent the offending config from reaching production and an alert for activation queues.

If you were impacted: reply here or schedule time: <booking link>. We're offering a one-time onboarding credit; claims accepted for 14 days.

Sincere apologies,
The Redwood Onboarding Team```

lena (CS): good. add a one-line note for high-touch customers offering an executive intro call + prioritize their tickets. Also confirm credit expiry 14 days.

omar (Eng): can we include a short status page link and a technical post-incident note? If yes, include placeholder: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1976543211

peter (CS): added status link + exec call line. Updated snippet: ```If you're a trial or renewal-risk customer, reply to this thread and we'll arrange a prioritized executive intro call. Full details: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1976543211```

rachel (Ops): internal affected list (private): alpha-inc, beta-studios, gamma-api, delta-partners, epsilon-edu, zeta-retail, eta-health, theta-solutions, iota-labs, kappa-systems, lambda-commerce, mu-analytics, nu-marketing, xi-platform, omicron-ai. Note: eta-health, delta-partners, and alpha-inc show webhook failures and need manual retries.

lena (CS): splitting outreach: 1) immediate personal DMs to the 4 highest renewal-risk trials (alpha-inc, epsilon-edu, lambda-commerce, omicron-ai) with exec offer; 2) group email to remaining affected; 3) shared spreadsheet to track responses + renewal-signal.

peter (CS): I'll send DMs now and paste copy. DM template: ```Hey <Name>, I wanted to personally let you know we had a brief onboarding delay this AM impacting final activation. Most accounts restored automatically; yours may require a quick retry. No data lost. If you'd like hands-on help or an exec intro call, I'm available: <booking link>. Were also issuing a one-time onboarding credit valid 14 days. Apologies for the trouble. - Peter```

omar (Eng): Ops also added a safeguard: a short-circuit path for activations failing after 3 retries so they go to a dedicated retry queue instead of timing out. Also added metric for 'activation_stuck_count'.

rachel (Ops): post-incident actions: 1) revert gating config to stricter review process; 2) add unit tests for retry/backoff interactions; 3) create runbook step for manual webhook retries; 4) tag follow-up PRs with incident ID 1976543211. I'll get PRs filed today.

lena (CS): before sending DMs: confirm no customer data loss? omar?

omar (Eng): confirmed - durable queue held payloads, no messages dropped. No PII exposed.

peter (CS): sending DMs now. Pasting one DM sent to alpha-inc: ```Hey Nina (@nina-ops) - quick note: we had a brief activation delay this morning that impacted some new accounts including yours. We've retried jobs and many completed automatically; your account needs a manual retry due to webhook timeouts. I'll coordinate a hands-on session now. Also offering a one-time onboarding credit valid for 14 days. Sorry about the interruption. - Peter```

lena (CS): good. please mark alpha-inc and delta-partners as "at-risk" in CRM and schedule a CS check-in within 24 hours. If still unactivated in 72 hours escalate to renewal team.

peter (CS): marked CRM and created calendar invites for check-ins.

incident-bot: [automated] Incident 1976543211 created  link: https://internal.incidents/1976543211  status: detected -> mitigated (partial).

rachel (Ops): ETA for manual retries: 12 hours for most, depends on webhook endpoint responsiveness. I'll label tickets with ETA and assign to oncall.

lena (CS): final: capture replies in the shared spreadsheet and note any "trial/renewal" signals. We'll reconvene in 90 minutes for a status update. Thanks everyone. :pray:
